hook: Hy-Nomas runs on one 24 GB RTX 4090; nothing smaller tested
items: Flagship phone: No, needs an NVIDIA GPU
Laptop, 8 GB, no GPU: No, needs an NVIDIA GPU
MacBook Air, 16 GB: No, needs an NVIDIA GPU
RTX 4060, 8 GB: No, a 100-second video peaks at 20.53 GiB
RTX 4090, 24 GB: Yes, 20.53 GiB peak (100 s video), INT8 plus CPU offload
Prompt following vs LingBot: Wins 75%, ties 16.7%, loses 8.3%
Camera control vs Genie 3: Mostly ties 54%; wins 32%, loses 14%
Spatial memory vs Genie 3: Behind, wins 13.3%, loses 30%
the_catch: The scores are the authors' own human ratings, and it still trails Genie 3 on long-term spatial consistency.
figure_sources: Flagship phone: https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy-Nomas (card lists NVIDIA driver and CUDA only)
Laptop, 8 GB, no GPU: https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy-Nomas (card lists NVIDIA driver and CUDA only)
MacBook Air, 16 GB: https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy-Nomas (card lists NVIDIA driver and CUDA only)
RTX 4060, 8 GB: https://arxiv.org/html/2610.36729 (Section 6.2, 20.53 GiB peak exceeds 8 GB)
RTX 4090, 24 GB: https://arxiv.org/html/2610.36729 (Section 6.2, 20.53 GiB peak for a 100-second 1280x704 video)
caption: Hy-Nomas is an 8B world model whose default launch needs eight GPUs. A single RTX 4090 works with INT8 weights and CPU offload. What do you run models on?
alt_text: A cheat sheet on whether Hy-Nomas runs on a phone, laptop, MacBook Air, RTX 4060 or RTX 4090, plus three human-rated comparisons.

es.hook: Hy‑Nomas se ejecuta en una RTX 4090 de 24 GB; no se probó nada más pequeño
items: Teléfono insignia: No, necesita una GPU NVIDIA
Portátil, 8 GB, sin GPU: No, necesita una GPU NVIDIA
MacBook Air, 16 GB: No, necesita una GPU NVIDIA
RTX 4060, 8 GB: No, un video de 100 s alcanza un pico de 20,53 GiB
RTX 4090, 24 GB: Sí, pico de 20,53 GiB (video de 100 s), INT8 y descarga a la CPU
Seguimiento de prompt vs LingBot: Gana 75 %, empata 16,7 %, pierde 8,3 %
Control de cámara vs Genie 3: Mayormente empata 54 %; gana 32 %; pierde 14 %
Memoria espacial vs Genie 3: Por detrás, gana 13,3 %, pierde 30 %
es.the_catch: Las puntuaciones son las propias valoraciones humanas de los autores, y aún queda detrás de Genie 3 en consistencia espacial a largo plazo
